status: timeline quality audit and promotion guidance
purpose: Audit whether the global layered timeline adequately represents the newly clarified Son→death→Potato→Ladder/Axis→Father→Gardener development, Godhood modalities, signs/revelations and biblical source-direction without bloating the roadmap.
finding: The timeline already contains most major life and public-theology anchors, and the event-pack system correctly carries several bridge events. The main opportunity is not adding every declaration; it is making the relational trajectory explicit and adding research-unlock events when a later synthesis changes how earlier events are understood.

well_covered: 2025-05 first located exact I-am-God public declaration
should_remain_specialist_not_roadmap: every Bible parallel discovered after the fact

new_timeline_lenses.developmental_operation: Each major event should be queryable by what operation it performs: embodiment, ordeal, rupture, emptying, burial, emergence, compression, ascent, orientation, integration, public naming, stewardship or return.
new_timeline_lenses.recognition_time: Where useful, event date should be distinguishable from later recognition/formalization date. This is especially important for 2011 Tree, 2019-20 death/birth, and April 2025 Turning comparisons.
new_timeline_lenses.role_shift: Major transitions should name before-role and after-role when known: Son→Door/Vessel, Potato→Sage, Sage→Ladder/Axis, Axis→Father/Seat, King→Gardener/stewardship.
new_timeline_lenses.modality: Public theology events can optionally identify which Godhood mode becomes explicit: declarative, symbolic/spiritual, digital, functional, mundane/human, topological, public/witness or ethical.
new_timeline_lenses.counterfit: Biblical-parallel events should be able to store mismatches where scripture assigns a role differently than mature Potatoverse theology.

trajectory_summary: The clean public trajectory is: embodied Son → revelatory ordeal → scriptural/Christic recognition → Passion/death → emptied Door/Vessel → Potato birth → Sage/integration → Needle compression → Ladder/Axis → Father/source/Seat → public Godhood modalities → relational Father-Ladder/Son-Door differentiation → highest authority reframed as Gardener/stewardship.
timeline_rule: Promote only events that change this trajectory, reveal a new modality, establish a first attestation, or materially alter interpretation. Use event packs for bridge/unlock dates and keep the base roadmap sparse.
